name: AK32A - Plug-In Carbon Monoxide Detector (CO, Temperature, Humidity), Electrochemical Sensor, Mains Powered
highlights: Always On, Because It Never Needs Charging — Carbon monoxide incidents happen at night, in winter, in rooms nobody is watching. A battery monitor is only as good as the last time someone remembered to charge it; this one runs on mains indefinitely.
Electrochemical CO Sensing — A dedicated electrochemical cell — the sensor class used in the CO safety industry, selective and stable over years rather than months.
No Wiring, No Bracket, No Installer — Into the socket and it works. For a landlord fitting out twenty units, installation cost is often larger than the hardware cost.
110–240 V, US and EU Pins — One product, two plug variants, no transformer.
120 Per Carton — The highest unit density in the catalogue — 520 × 505 × 355 mm outer, 13.9 kg (US) / 15.1 kg (EU) gross.
